records.text: An unnamed Mossad agent said Mossad could create layered foreign shell companies that could not be traced to Israel and use them to alter supply chains in its favor.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 5NQyGuRYbU8)

appearances.snippet: We have an incredible array of possibilities of creating foreign companies that have no way being traced back to Israel, shell companies over shell companies who affect the supply chain to our favor.

verification.notes: The 60 Minutes transcript directly records a disguised former Mossad agent describing foreign shell companies layered to affect the supply chain in Israel’s favor.
